investor_scope: KOSPI200 aggregate spot cash net purchase amount
investor_use: previous trading day's value ranked against its preceding 252 trading days
universe: previous trading day close KOSPI ordinary individual-security full-market-cap top 3; next day effective
market_demand_weights: top3 market cap normalized within top3; fitted predictive factor, not ETF replication weights

target_rules.T2_absorption: pre-shock completed 5-minute volume-weighted trade price minus one ETF tick
target_rules.T3_pressure_breakout: pre-breakout 5-minute box high plus box height
target_rules.D_market_demand: current ETF close * (1 + prior-20-day OLS predicted next-5-minute ETF return), rounded down to tick
target_rules.M_breakout: pre-breakout 5-minute box high plus box height
target_rules.M_open_close: 15:00 entry-reference * (1 + prior-252-day OLS predicted final-30-minute return), rounded down to tick
target_rules.M_investor_trend: same measured-move target as M_breakout, without compression gate

stop_rules.T2_absorption: shock-minute low minus one ETF tick
stop_rules.T3_pressure_breakout: pre-breakout 5-minute box low minus one ETF tick
stop_rules.D_market_demand: completed 5-minute low minus one ETF tick
stop_rules.M_breakout: pre-breakout 5-minute box low minus one ETF tick
stop_rules.M_open_close: 14:30-15:00 completed range low minus one ETF tick
stop_rules.M_investor_trend: completed 5-minute low minus one ETF tick

execution: signal after minute closes; leave one whole minute for latency; entry following minute open (signal index + 2). Missing consecutive minutes cancel entry. TP requires high >= target + tick. Same-bar SL takes priority. Stop gap uses adverse open. Entry rejected if stop >= open or remaining target distance < 6bp. One position per strategy. Re-arm after raw setup false, and no new same-minute exit/re-entry.
eod: normal strategies sell at 15:19 open; early-close/missing liquidation bar disables entire day. M_open_close includes actual 15:30 auction print if available, never treats it as continuous 15:29 trading. TP/SL continuous until 15:20; auction unresolved positions at actual auction print.
research_history: All historical results exploratory. 2026-07-22..2026-10-06 prior OOS already consumed. No fresh OOS claims, no parameter grid or selection by best result.
